title: Broken after 1 month.
text: Broken after 1 month.. First of all some USB ports would not power it on at all from the get go and then after 1 month of use one of the speeds stopped working.

product_metadata.title: COMLIFE USB Desk Fan with Remote, 8 inch Portable Table Fan with 3 Speeds Strong Airflow, RGB Light, Quiet Operation and 360 Degree Rotate for Home Office Bedroom, Black
features: 【USB POWERED】This desk fan is USB powered, so adapter, laptop, power bank, car charger, or any device with USB output port could be the power source.Battery-free design sets no limit to the running hours, and makes it safer to use for long time even in the Sun.

【RGB LIGHT 3 TIMERS】Equipped with RGB mood light, the table fan could create a romantic atmosphere or light up your night. Choose among 3 light modes, 5 brightness levelsand 7 colors, you can have it set in solid red, white, green, yellow, purple, blue, cyan, or automatically change colors gradually. Comes with 3 timers, it will automatically turn off in 1/3/5 hours. Customize your own lighting and time as needed.

【POWERFUL QUIET】The USB fan delivers up to 11.8 ft./s powerful yet quiet airflow that you will enjoy the cool breeze without being disturbed. It has 3 adjustable speeds, and the 360° pivoting head will offer you the most comfortable air circulation in scorcher.

【REMOTE OR BUTTON CONTROL】Comes with a remote for your easy control from as far as 16 feet away. (Tip: Take out the insulation sheet on the back of the remote to ensure normal use). You can also control the fan simply by pressing the buttons on the back of the head. Designed with a groove at the bottom of the base, so you can conveniently keep the remote or little items in there to avoid missing.

【LIGHTWEIGHT PORTABLE】The 8 inch table fan is light in weight and compact in size, it can fit into your suitcase or any room corner without taking up much space, so you can carry it around or set it anywhere easily. It is great to keep you cool and the air circulated when you are at home, office, dorm, in cars, hotel, etc. on sticky summer weather.
description: Product Description: The 8 inch desk fan provides a quiet and efficient means of cooling a surrounding area. Comes with a remote, you can control the fan not only by pressing the buttons on the back of the head, but also from up to 16 ft. away. It has RGB mood light to provide the light you may need at midnight and create a romantic atmosphere for you. 360° pivoting head will keep you cool in the direction you want. Tip: Take out the insulation sheet on the back of the remote to ensure normal use Specifications: Input: 5V/2A Power: 8W USB Port: USBA Fan Speed: High/Medium/Low Remote Control Distance: 16 ft. max. Size: 9.7*3.9*9.3 inch Weight: 1.3 lb. Package Content: 8’’ Desktop Fan*1 Remote*1 User Manual*1
